review.finding: Wide-char fix applied to every empty cell on non-last rows, gluing mid-row blanks (CUF-moved TUI output) into one token.
review.suggestion: Only drop the empty cell at the wrap point (x === cols-1); add a mid-row empty-cell test.

review.finding: spacedHead looks back one token only; paths with two or more spaces still link their tail (C:\Program Files\My App\a.ts -> App\a.ts).
review.suggestion: Carry the suppressed state forward while following tokens contain a separator and do not start a new absolute path; add tests.

review.finding: MAX_ROWS checked after both isWrapped loops walked the whole block.
TSC_SUFFIX re-run after every stripped char: O(n^2) on very long tokens.
review.suggestion: Skip tokens longer than 1024 up front; run TSC_SUFFIX only when the token ends with ')'.

review.finding: createClickGuard.isClick packs four conditions in one expression; the !el fallback is undocumented.
review.suggestion: Named early returns plus a comment.

review.finding: Cleanup order: terminal disposed before the provider subscription; tolerated by xterm but untested.

notes: ILinkProvider ranges, 0/1-based conversion, single registration per mount, StrictMode, stale-probe handling, hook ordering, web links untouched, token-only colours, no inline suppressions, AC-8 scope verified.
